headline.title: The current bottleneck is political will, not research
headline.summary: The article argues that the primary obstacle to AI safety is not a lack of research but rather insufficient political will to implement existing best practices and regulatory frameworks. It highlights that awareness of AI risks is low among policymakers, hindering the enforcement of necessary safety measures.

articles.title: OpenAI bets on families as ChatGPT goes deeper into households
articles.summary: OpenAI is seeking a product manager to develop ChatGPT features tailored for families, caregivers, and older adults, as indicated by a recent job posting. This move reflects the company's strategy to enhance its AI offerings for household use.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Head of Safety Is Leaving the Company
articles.summary: OpenAI's Head of Safety, Johannes Heidecke, is leaving the company amid efforts to better integrate its research and safety teams. His departure marks a significant change as OpenAI continues to focus on enhancing safety protocols within its operations.

articles.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
articles.summary: Meta has disabled a recently announced Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI-generated images using content from public accounts by tagging them, following backlash regarding privacy concerns. The feature had raised issues as it permitted the use of public account content for AI creations without the owner's consent.

articles.title: Meta removes controversial AI feature on Instagram after backlash
articles.summary: Meta has removed a controversial AI feature on Instagram following user backlash, stating that the tool did not meet expectations. The company acknowledged the feedback and emphasized its intent to provide a useful creative resource.

articles.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
articles.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, claiming that former Apple employees at the AI startup stole trade secrets related to hardware development. The complaint also includes IO Products, the hardware company founded by Jony Ive, as a defendant in the case.
